name: Brainstorm lists of fictional game world-building elements
description: Users asked to generate comprehensive lists of fictional game mechanics, world-building elements, and narrative components such as character classes, cultures, traits, quests, and setting-specific status systems. The requests focused on brainstorming diverse, structured, or exhaustive options for various fantasy, sci-fi, and role-playing game contexts.
